    "At the start, estimated contact forces are near zero/noise level, e.g. t=16423544 has ecfo2=0.2 and t=16423742 has ecfo2=0.03.",
    "A sudden force event begins while the machine remains stationary: ecfo2 rises to 6.9 at t=16424236, then 22.08 at t=16424335, and 29.51 at t=16424434.",

  ],

Effort target torques remain essentially constant, e.g. etto1=-13.91 and etto2 about -6.42 throughout, so the observed symptom is not a commanded torque or position change.

If no physical obstruction is found, inspect and recalibrate the contact-force estimation/sensing path associated with the affected axis/channel, then verify with a no-load stationary test that ecfo2 stays near zero and no new position or speed deviation appears.

parsed.root_cause: Unexpected external contact or obstruction/load on the machine while it is stationary; the telemetry supports abnormal contact force, but it does not uniquely identify the exact object or mechanism causing the contact.
evidence: After t=13147114, feedback_speed_0 through feedback_speed_5 are 0 and feedback positions remain fixed at approximately fpo0=-1.03, fpo1=-2.32, fpo2=-1.04, fpo3=3.37, fpo4=-1.15, fpo5=-1.55, matching the setpoint positions, so the machine is not commanded to move.
Estimated contact forces are near baseline before the event, for example at t=13148893 ecfo0=0.08, ecfo1=-0.08, ecfo2=-0.08 while speeds are all 0.
A sudden force spike appears while still stationary: at t=13149091 ecfo0=-2.41, ecfo1=4.55, ecfo2=7.55, and at t=13149190 ecfo0=-3.94, ecfo1=11.22, ecfo2=19.76.

The abnormal force remains sustained with no corresponding motion or setpoint change: from t=13149289 through t=13150574, ecfo2 stays high around 21 to 24.5 and ecfo1 remains around 7 to 12 while feedback speeds remain 0.

Effort target torques remain essentially steady during the sustained force period, especially etto1 around 15.03 and etto2 around 6.61, indicating the main observed anomaly is the estimated contact force rather than a new commanded motion.
corrective_actions: Pause the operation and inspect the machine workspace, end effector, fixture, part, and any nearby cabling or tooling for unintended contact or a trapped/misaligned load; clear or realign the obstruction, then verify estimated contact forces return near the pre-event baseline while the machine remains at the same stationary setpoint.

After clearing the contact, run a controlled low-risk motion or repeat the stationary hold and verify feedback positions continue to track setpoints, feedback speeds behave as commanded, and ecfo1/ecfo2 do not show sustained spikes like the t=13149091 onward event.

If no physical contact or obstruction is found, check the contact-force estimation path or related sensing for a false force reading, then verify by confirming the estimated contact forces remain near baseline under the same stationary conditions.
